steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.text: Mix flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt in the mixer. Add eggs, milk, oil and vanilla and mix on medium for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Add the hot liquid
steps.text: On low speed, slowly pour in the hot coffee. The batter will be thin, which is normal.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Divide between two lined 20 cm pans. Bake until a toothpick comes out clean, then cool completely.

steps.title: Make the ganache
steps.text: Heat the cream until steaming, pour over the chopped chocolate, wait 2 minutes, and stir smooth. Let it thicken, then fill and cover the cake.

name: Carrot Cake with Cream Cheese Frosting

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.text: Beat brown sugar, oil and eggs on medium for 2 minutes. Stir in the carrots.

steps.title: Add dry ingredients
steps.text: Add flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt on low until just combined. Fold in the walnuts.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into a lined 23 cm square pan. Bake until a toothpick comes out clean, then cool completely.

steps.title: Frost
steps.text: Beat cream cheese and butter until smooth, add powdered sugar and vanilla, and spread over the cooled cake.

steps.title: Whip the eggs
steps.text: Rub the zest into the sugar, then whisk with the eggs on medium-high for 3 minutes until pale and thick.

steps.title: Add the wet ingredients
steps.text: Stream in the olive oil, milk and lemon juice on low speed.

steps.title: Fold in the flour
steps.text: Fold in the flour, baking powder and salt by hand just until no streaks remain.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Pour into a lined 20 cm round pan. Bake until golden and a toothpick comes out clean.

steps.title: Make the streusel
steps.text: Rub the streusel ingredients together with your fingers until clumpy. Chill while you make the batter.

steps.title: Mix the batter
steps.text: Cream butter and sugar for 3 minutes, add eggs and vanilla, then alternate the dry ingredients and sour cream on low.

steps.title: Assemble
steps.text: Spread half the batter in a lined 23 cm pan, scatter over a third of the streusel, add the remaining batter, and top with the rest of the streusel.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the yolks
steps.text: Whisk yolks and sugar in a heatproof bowl over barely simmering water until thick and about 71 °C, which takes 5 to 8 minutes. This makes the cream safer to eat. Let it cool completely.

steps.title: Make the cream
steps.text: Beat the cooled yolk mixture with the mascarpone until smooth. In the mixer, whip the cream to stiff peaks and fold it in.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Dip each ladyfinger in the coffee for 1 to 2 seconds and arrange half in the dish. Spread half the cream on top, then repeat.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cover and chill so the layers set. Dust with cocoa just before serving.
